title: protoboard-iso timeline
description: A tour of a circuit's page and the script of a video: written once, played the same every time.

theme.description: The page's theme in a recording: stage (default, the notebook at night), notebook (by day), light or dark (the bench). A link's ?theme= wins over this

captionLines.description: The lines a caption may take (default 2). More lines: a portrait recording lowers the oscilloscope and the circuit to keep air around it

pace.description: Seconds of simulated time per second of video in this recording (default: the page's own, which render-frames.js --parts prints): a slower circuit shown faster so its cycles fit the shot; the oscilloscope, the compare figures and the payoff follow it

title.description: In a recording, the box's title instead of the kit's ("" for none)

note.description: The note under the trace instead of the kit's ("" for none)

window.description: In a recording, the time the box always shows, in s of the oscilloscope's time (simulated, or the wall clock in a circuit that does not change by itself): from t = 0, then scrolling, so a set that changes the pace shows as more or fewer cycles instead of a new scale (default: the kit's window, which stretches and rescales; render-frames.js --parts gives it and how fast time runs)

marks.description: In a recording, a dashed line in the box at each set from then on, with the control's new value, so before and after both read (default false)

place.description: In a portrait recording, where the box lies: bottom, from 56 % to 75 % of the height, the circuit framed above it from 40 % to 56 % (default); top, from 28 % to 40 %, between a caption of at most two lines (and no value) and the circuit, which keeps the band from 40 % to 75 %

size.description: compact: no title and no note, the value inside the trace, two axis labels (the top of the scale and the end of the window), for a box of 12 % of the height (default full)

compare.description: In a recording, at each set: the cycles before it kept as a faint ghost trace laid over what comes after, and the change of period from the simulation, once the control has arrived ("period 0.12 s → 0.86 s (×7)"; with an LED in the circuit, in words: "on 0.08 → 0.40 s · off the same"), laid out in bands so no text crosses the trace; implies marks (default false)

change.description: How a comparing box says the change: ratio, a proportion true at any pace ("on ×5 · off the same", default); times, in the oscilloscope's seconds ("on 0.08 → 0.40 s · off the same")

oneOf.description: One string per language code, e.g. { "en": "…", "es": "…" }

say.description: A comparing box's own words for the change instead of the kit's, with {k} for how many times longer the LED stays on (the period without an LED) and {k2} for off, both from the simulation ("on {k}× longer · off the same")

reading.description: false: the trace's name without its value now (default true)

clock.description: compact, false: without the time at the end of the window (default true)

oneOf.description: The page opens the part's or strip's card with its oscilloscope; a recording shows the oscilloscope in a box of its own, the camera leaving it room
